acts_of_service.title: Immediate Doorway Baby Swap & Arms Break
acts_of_service.action: The second you walk through the door, greet her warmly and immediately take the baby so she can drop her arms, stretch, and catch her breath.
acts_of_service.why: She's been holding/soothing a fussy baby all day. Immediate physical relief when you get home changes her entire evening.

acts_of_service.title: 45-Min Libby Thriller & Skincare Window
acts_of_service.action: Tell her in a quiet home moment: 'I have the baby completely taken care of for the next 45 minutes. Go take a hot shower, queue up your Libby thriller, and do your skincare routine without rushing.'
acts_of_service.why: Protects her favorite self-care ritual without her feeling guilty, interrupted, or rushed.

acts_of_service.title: Seasonal Coffee Surprise Run
acts_of_service.action: Surprise her with her favorite fun seasonal coffee drink (e.g. Pumpkin Spice, Maple Pecan, or seasonal cold foam latte) and a handwritten note on her cup.
acts_of_service.why: A thoughtful mid-morning gesture that brightens a sleep-deprived day.

acts_of_service.title: Sour Candy / Low-Carb Evening Treat Run
acts_of_service.action: Surprise her with her favorite sour candy / licorice treat or a health-conscious high-protein dessert for after baby goes to sleep.
acts_of_service.why: Satisfies sweet cravings while respecting your mutual weight loss & health goals.

acts_of_service.title: Unprompted Evening Kitchen Reset
acts_of_service.action: Do a complete kitchen reset after dinner (dishes, counters wiped, trash out) without asking or making a big deal.
acts_of_service.why: Eliminates morning stress so she doesn't wake up to yesterday's mess.

acts_of_service.title: Low-Carb Thai Takeout Night
acts_of_service.action: Suggest ordering Thai takeout for dinner, picking high-protein, lower-carb options: Thai Basil Chicken stir-fry with extra veggies, Chicken Satay, or Papaya Salad.
acts_of_service.why: Gives her a favorite takeout treat while keeping carb intake low.

acts_of_service.title: Bedtime Routine Takeover
acts_of_service.action: Tell her quietly at 6 PM: 'I've got bedtime completely covered tonight. Go relax.'
acts_of_service.why: Gives her uninterrupted quiet time after a demanding day caring for the baby.

acts_of_service.title: Blanchard Park Solo Walk Window
acts_of_service.action: Take the baby out for a 1.5-hour stroller walk along Blanchard Park trail so she gets a quiet, empty house to unwind.
acts_of_service.why: Quiet solitude in her own home is one of the most valued gifts for a full-time stay-at-home mom.

acts_of_service.title: Morning Hydration & Fuel Station
acts_of_service.action: Before leaving for work, fill a 32oz tumbler with ice water and prep her coffee mug next to it with a note: 'Fuel for the best mom. I love you.'
acts_of_service.why: Stay-at-home moms often forget to hydrate during hectic sleep-deprived mornings.

acts_of_service.title: Baby Laundry Secret Wash & Fold
acts_of_service.action: Wash, fold, and put away all the baby's laundry and onesies without asking.
acts_of_service.why: Baby clothes multiply constantly; clearing the pile takes invisible mental weight off her.

acts_of_service.title: Stroller Maintenance & Trunk Prep
acts_of_service.action: Wipe down her stroller, clean out the trunk, and restock the diaper bag with fresh wipes, diapers, and water bottles.
acts_of_service.why: Makes her next outing effortless and stress-free.

acts_of_service.title: Nighttime Foot & Calf Massage
acts_of_service.action: Offer a 15-minute foot and calf massage while sitting on the couch after baby is asleep, no expectations attached.
acts_of_service.why: Relieves physical soreness from standing and pacing with a baby all day.

acts_of_service.title: Healthy Meal-Prep Assist
acts_of_service.action: Pre-cut fresh veggies, grill high-protein chicken breasts, or prep protein snacks for the fridge so her daytime lunches are effortless.
acts_of_service.why: Directly supports your mutual health goals and saves her daytime prep energy.

acts_of_service.title: Midnight Bottle / Wake-up Duty Promise
acts_of_service.action: Tell her before bed: 'I'm taking 100% of the wake-ups tonight. You wear earplugs and get uninterrupted sleep.'
acts_of_service.why: Deep, unbroken sleep is the ultimate gift during sleep-deprived months.

acts_of_service.title: Car Gas Tank Fill & Clean Routine
acts_of_service.action: Take her car while she relaxes at home, fill the gas tank, and vacuum out the front seats.
acts_of_service.why: Saves her from having to gas up with a fussy baby in the backseat.

words_of_affirmation.title: Motherhood Effort Praise Voice Note
words_of_affirmation.action: Send a 30-second voice note mid-morning: 'I know how exhausting these fussy baby days are. Your effort, patience, and love for our family don't go unnoticed. You are an incredible mom.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Directly praises her hard work & resilience during tough sleep-deprived days.

words_of_affirmation.title: Mirror Sticky Note: Effort & Beauty
words_of_affirmation.action: Leave a sticky note on the bathroom mirror: 'I see how hard you work every day for us. You are amazing, beautiful, and deeply appreciated.'
words_of_affirmation.why: A visual surprise right where she does her morning/evening skincare.

words_of_affirmation.title: Specific Hard Work Recognition Text
words_of_affirmation.action: Text her mid-afternoon: 'Thank you for giving so much of your energy to our baby today. I know it's exhausting, and I'm coming home ready to take over!'
words_of_affirmation.why: Reassures her that help is coming and validates her daily effort.

words_of_affirmation.title: Quiet Home Hug & Effort Validation
words_of_affirmation.action: In a quiet moment at home, wrap your arms around her waist, hold her close, look into her eyes, and tell her how much you love and admire her.
words_of_affirmation.why: Pushes emotional romance in her preferred private home setting.

words_of_affirmation.title: Libby Thriller Recommendation Text
words_of_affirmation.action: Send her a screenshot or link to a trending high-rated thriller book on Libby: 'Saw this new thriller pop up and thought of your shower unwind time!'
words_of_affirmation.why: Shows you pay attention to her specific reading interests.

words_of_affirmation.title: Gratitude for the Unseen Work
words_of_affirmation.action: Say to her after dinner: 'I was thinking about everything you do behind the scenes that no one sees—the patience, the care, the endless soothing. I see it, and I admire you so much.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Stay-at-home moms often feel invisible; recognizing unseen labor builds deep connection.

words_of_affirmation.title: Physical Attraction Compliment
words_of_affirmation.action: Catch her eye across the room, walk over, and whisper: 'You look so gorgeous today. I'm the luckiest guy.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Reminds her that she is desirable and loved as a woman, not just as a mom.

words_of_affirmation.title: Text Memory Callback
words_of_affirmation.action: Send her a photo from a past date or trip together: 'Randomly came across this memory today. I love building this life with you.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Sparks nostalgic warmth amidst the daily routine.

words_of_affirmation.title: Praise Her Patience Under Pressure
words_of_affirmation.action: Tell her: 'The way you stay calm and gentle even when baby is crying all day inspires me. You're doing a fantastic job.'
words_of_affirmation.why: Reinforces her maternal confidence when she feels worn out.

words_of_affirmation.title: Written Love Letter Tuck
words_of_affirmation.action: Write a short 3-sentence love letter on a card and tuck it into her thriller notebook or skincare pouch.
words_of_affirmation.why: A tangible physical token of affection she can re-read.

creative_home_experiences.title: Living Room Candlelight Mocktail / Tasting Session
creative_home_experiences.action: After baby is asleep, dim the main lights, light candles, and serve a low-carb sparkling mocktail or craft soda in wine glasses on the couch.
creative_home_experiences.why: Creates an upscale lounge ambiance right in your living room with zero effort.

creative_home_experiences.title: Backyard Stargazing & Warm Tea/Coffee
creative_home_experiences.action: Step outside onto the patio for 15 minutes after baby's bedtime with warm mugs of tea or decaf coffee to look at the stars together.
creative_home_experiences.why: A quiet, peaceful breath of fresh air away from indoor chores.

creative_home_experiences.title: At-Home Foot Spa & Acoustic Music Night
creative_home_experiences.action: Fill a basin with warm water and bath salts, put on soft acoustic music, and let her soak her feet while you chat.
creative_home_experiences.why: Brings the spa experience home to her favorite environment.

creative_home_experiences.title: Listen to a Thriller Audiobook Chapter Together
creative_home_experiences.action: Ask her to play 15 minutes of her current Libby thriller over a Bluetooth speaker while cuddling on the couch.
creative_home_experiences.why: Shows genuine interest in her favorite hobby and builds shared excitement.

creative_home_experiences.title: Low-Carb Dessert Bar Setup
creative_home_experiences.action: Set up a tray on the coffee table with dark chocolate, berries, whipped cream, and sour gummies for a cozy movie night.
creative_home_experiences.why: Turns evening snack time into an intentional mini-date.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Seasonal Cold Foam Latte Drop-off
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Order a seasonal iced latte on your way home and hand it to her right after taking the baby.
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: A delicious, thoughtful pick-me-up that shows you were thinking of her during your workday.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Sour Candy / Licorice Secret Stash
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Hide a small bag of her favorite sour candy or licorice in her nightstand drawer with a note: 'For when you need a sweet moment.'
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: A playful secret surprise she'll discover when unwinding.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Bakery Item Treat for Two
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Pick up a single high-quality bakery pastry to split together over coffee on a weekend morning.
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: Shared indulgence in moderation fits your health goals while enjoying a treat.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: New Skincare / Body Lotion Gift
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Surprise her with a nice hydrating body cream or face sheet mask for her shower routine.
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: Directly enhances her cherished self-care ritual.

thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.title: Surprise Low-Carb Thai Feast Night
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.action: Tell her at 4:30 PM: 'Dinner is completely taken care of tonight! I'm bringing home Thai takeout.'
thoughtful_surprises_and_treats.why: Saves her from afternoon meal-planning fatigue.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The 'What Made You Smile Today?' Check-In
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her over dinner or on the couch: 'What was the sweetest or funniest moment with baby today?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Helps shift focus to positive parenting moments after a hard day.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Dream Vacation Prompt
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her: 'If we could take a 3-day trip anywhere next year just the two of us, where would you want to go?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Sparks exciting future planning and romance.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The 'How Can I Support You Best This Week?' Question
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her: 'What is one thing I can take off your plate this week to make your days feel lighter?'

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Thriller Plot Breakdown
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her: 'Tell me about the plot twist in your current Libby book! Who do you think did it?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Gives her space to talk passionately about her reading.

conversational_prompts_and_questions.title: The Memory Lane Question
conversational_prompts_and_questions.action: Ask her: 'Do you remember the first time we realized we were crazy about each other?'
conversational_prompts_and_questions.why: Re-anchors your relationship in romantic history.

date_ideas.title: Tactical Brewing Craft Beer Afternoon (Stroller Friendly)
date_ideas.prep: Head over to Tactical Brewing in Baldwin Park. Sit on the outdoor patio with baby in the stroller, grab fresh craft beers & enjoy the lake breeze.
date_ideas.why: Explores a local Orlando craft brewery without needing a babysitter; baby rests in stroller.

date_ideas.title: Bowigens Beer Company Afternoon Outing
date_ideas.prep: Visit Bowigens Beer Company in Avalon Park. Enjoy casual craft brews on the patio with the stroller.
date_ideas.why: Close to 32825, casual, stroller friendly, great craft beer variety.

date_ideas.title: Lake Baldwin Scenic Walk with Seasonal Coffee
date_ideas.prep: Grab seasonal iced lattes and walk the 2.5-mile Lake Baldwin trail with baby in the stroller.
date_ideas.why: Local East Orlando scenery, gets outdoor steps (supports weight loss goals), zero babysitter needed.

date_ideas.title: Jay Blanchard Park Riverside Stroll
date_ideas.prep: Walk along the shaded paved river trail at Jay Blanchard Park right in 32825 with stroller and cold beverages.
date_ideas.why: Shaded, peaceful, right in your neighborhood, great for baby sleep.

date_ideas.title: Low-Carb Thai Feast & Thriller Movie Night
date_ideas.prep: Order high-protein Thai takeout after baby goes to bed at 7:30 PM. Set up cozy dim lighting, open a low-carb drink, and enjoy a thriller movie.
date_ideas.why: Zero surprise schedule anxiety, 100% relaxed home atmosphere, high romance after baby's bedtime.

date_ideas.title: Park Avenue Stroll & Specialty Drink Exploration
date_ideas.prep: Stroll down cobblestone Park Avenue in Winter Park with stroller, grab a specialty drink, and explore the rose gardens.
date_ideas.why: Beautiful public atmosphere, stroller-friendly, fun exploration.
